title: Observer-Based Measurement of Facial Expression with the Facial Action Coding System
summary:
Abstract
                  Facial expression has been a focus of emotion research for over a hundred years (Darwin, 1872/1998). It is central to several leading theories of emotion (Ekman, 1992; Izard, 1977; Tomkins, 1962) and has been the focus of at times heated debate about issues in emotion science (Ekman, 1973, 1993; Fridlund, 1992; Russell, 1994). Facial expression figures prominently in research on almost every aspect of emotion, including psychophysiology (Levenson, Ekman, & Friesen, 1990), neural bases (Calder et al., 1996; Davidson, Ekman, Saron, Senulis, & Friesen, 1990), development (Malatesta, Culver, Tesman, & Shephard, 1989; Matias & Cohn, 1993), perception (Ambadar, Schooler, & Cohn, 2005), social processes (Hatfield, Cacioppo, & Rapson, 1992; Hess & Kirouac, 2000), and emotion disorder (Kaiser, 2002; Sloan, Straussa, Quirka, & Sajatovic, 1997), to name a few.

标题：基于观察者的面部表情测量：面部动作编码系统
摘要：面部表情作为情绪研究的焦点已逾百年（Darwin, 1872/1998）。它是若干重要情绪理论的核心（Ekman, 1992; Izard, 1977; Tomkins, 1962），并且一直是情绪科学中一些议题上时而激烈辩论的焦点（Ekman, 1973, 1993; Fridlund, 1992; Russell, 1994）。面部表情在几乎情绪所有方面的研究中都占据突出地位，包括心理生理学（Levenson, Ekman, & Friesen, 1990）、神经基础（Calder et al., 1996; Davidson, Ekman, Saron, Senulis, & Friesen, 1990）、发展（Malatesta, Culver, Tesman, & Shephard, 1989; Matias & Cohn, 1993）、知觉（Ambadar, Schooler, & Cohn, 2005）、社会过程（Hatfield, Cacioppo, & Rapson, 1992; Hess & Kirouac, 2000）以及情绪障碍（Kaiser, 2002; Sloan, Straussa, Quirka, & Sajatovic, 1997）等，不胜枚举。
关键词：面部表情；面部动作编码系统；情绪研究；观察者测量；社会认知

title: Is Infant-Directed Speech Prosody a Result of the Vocal Expression of Emotion?
summary: Many studies have found that infant-directed (ID) speech has higher pitch, has more exaggerated pitch contours, has a larger pitch range, has a slower tempo, and is more rhythmic than typical adult-directed (AD) speech. We show that the ID speech style reflects free vocal expression of emotion to infants, in comparison with more inhibited expression of emotion in typical AD speech. When AD speech does express emotion, the same acoustic features are used as in ID speech. We recorded ID and AD samples of speech expressing love-comfort, fear, and surprise. The emotions were equally discriminable in the ID and AD samples. Acoustic analyses showed few differences between the ID and AD samples, but robust differences across the emotions. We conclude that ID prosody itself is not special. What is special is the widespread expression of emotion to infants in comparison with the more inhibited expression of emotion in typical adult interactions.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：婴儿导向言语的韵律是情绪声音表达的结果吗？
摘要：许多研究发现，与典型的成人导向言语相比，婴儿导向言语具有更高的音高、更夸张的音高轮廓、更大的音高范围、更慢的语速以及更强的节奏性。我们表明，婴儿导向言语风格反映了对婴儿的情绪的自由声音表达，而典型成人导向言语中的情绪表达则更为抑制。当成人导向言语确实表达情绪时，所使用的声学特征与婴儿导向言语相同。我们录制了表达爱意-安抚、恐惧和惊讶的婴儿导向与成人导向言语样本。这些情绪在婴儿导向和成人导向样本中具有同等的可辨别性。声学分析显示，婴儿导向与成人导向样本之间差异很少，但不同情绪之间存在稳健差异。我们得出结论：婴儿导向韵律本身并不特殊。特殊之处在于，与典型成人互动中更受抑制的情绪表达相比，对婴儿的情绪表达更为普遍。
关键词：婴儿导向言语；情绪表达；韵律；声学分析；成人导向言语

title: Differentiating emotion elicited and deliberate emotional facial expressions
summary:
Abstract
                  Recent research suggests the potential importance of dynamic aspects (e.g. speed of onset and offset and degree of irregularity) of facial movement for the encoding of spontaneous versus deliberate emotional facial expressions. The present studies were conducted to investigate whether emotion elicited and deliberate facial expressions of happiness and disgust differ regarding their dynamic features. Two experiments were designed to elicit spontaneous and deliberate facial expressions of happiness and disgust. The experiments differed regarding the deliberate facial expressions, which were either poses (Experiment 1) or masking deceptions (Experiment 2). Experiment 2 confirmed Ekman and Friesen S (1982) notion, that spontaneous expressions have slower onsets and offsets than do deliberate expressions. The data show that dynamic aspects of the facial expressions differentiate between elicitation conditions. However, the evidence was more consistently found for the degree of irregularity of the expression than for the speed of onset and offset.

标题：区分情绪诱发的和故意的面部表情
摘要：近期研究表明，面部运动的动态特征（如起始和终止速度以及不规则程度）对于编码自发的与故意的情绪面部表情可能具有潜在重要性。本研究旨在考察快乐和厌恶的情绪诱发面部表情与故意面部表情在动态特征上是否存在差异。研究设计了两项实验以诱发快乐和厌恶的自发与故意面部表情。两项实验在故意面部表情方面有所不同，分别为姿势性表情（实验1）和掩饰性欺骗表情（实验2）。实验2证实了Ekman和Friesen（1982）的观点，即自发表情的起始和终止速度慢于故意表情。数据表明，面部表情的动态特征能够区分不同的诱发条件。然而，相较于起始和终止速度，表情的不规则程度这一证据更为一致。
关键词：情绪面部表情；自发表情；故意表情；动态特征；欺骗

title: The cues decoders use in attempting to differentiate emotion‐elicited and posed facial expressions
summary:
Abstract
                  Dynamic facial expressions, either posed or elicited by afectively evocative materials, were objectively scored to determine the movement cues and temporal parameters associated with the two types of expression. Subjects viewed these expressive episodes and rated each of them on a number of scales intended to assess perceived spontaneousness and deliberateness. Subsequent to viewing all stimuli, subjects reported the specfic cues that they felt they had used to discriminate spontaneous from deliberate expressions. The results reveal that (a) subjects were able to accurately report the cues they employed in the rating task and that (b) these cues were not always valid discriminators of posed and spontaneous expressions. Subjects were in fact relatively poor at identifying expressions of the two types and this low discrimination accuracy was found to be a function of the consistent use of these invalid cues. A measure of the level of perceived honest demeanour of the stimulus persons based on their neutral expressions was found to relate to perceivers accuracy in discriminating posed and spontaneous expressions.

相关性：是
标题：解码者试图区分情绪诱发面部表情与伪装面部表情时所使用的线索
摘要：动态面部表情，无论是由情绪诱发材料引发的还是伪装出来的，均被客观评分，以确定与这两类表情相关的运动线索和时间参数。被试观看这些表情片段，并在若干量表上对其进行评分，这些量表旨在评估感知到的自发性和故意性。在观看完所有刺激后，被试报告了他们自认为用于区分自发表情和故意表情的具体线索。结果表明：（a）被试能够准确报告他们在评分任务中所使用的线索；（b）这些线索并不总是区分伪装表情和自发表情的有效判别依据。事实上，被试在识别这两类表情时表现相对较差，而这种较低的辨别准确率被发现与一致使用这些无效线索有关。基于刺激人物的中性表情所测量到的感知诚实 demeanor 水平，被发现与知觉者区分伪装表情和自发表情的准确率有关。
关键词：面部表情；情绪诱发；伪装表情；线索利用；辨别准确率

title: Social‐cognitive, physiological, and neural mechanisms underlying emotion regulation impairments: understanding anxiety in autism spectrum disorder
summary:
Abstract
                  Anxiety is one of the most common clinical problems among children, adolescents, and adults with autism spectrum disorder (ASD), yet we know little about its etiology in the context of ASD. We posit that emotion regulation (ER) impairments are a risk factor for anxiety in ASD. Specifically, we propose that one reason why anxiety disorders are so frequently comorbid with ASD is because ER impairments are ubiquitous to ASD, stemming from socio‐cognitive, physiological, and neurological processes related to impaired cognitive control, regulatory processes, and arousal. In this review, we offer a developmental model of how ER impairments may arise in ASD, and when (moderating influences) and how (meditational mechanisms) they result in anxiety.

标题：自闭症谱系障碍中情绪调节损伤背后的社会认知、生理与神经机制：理解焦虑
摘要：焦虑是自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）儿童、青少年和成人中最常见的临床问题之一，但我们对其在ASD背景下的病因知之甚少。我们假设情绪调节（ER）损伤是ASD中焦虑的一个风险因素。具体而言，我们提出，焦虑障碍之所以如此频繁地与ASD共病，原因之一在于ER损伤在ASD中普遍存在，其根源与认知控制、调节过程和唤醒受损相关的社会认知、生理和神经过程有关。在这篇综述中，我们提供了一个发展模型，说明ER损伤如何在ASD中产生，以及它们何时（调节性影响）和如何（中介机制）导致焦虑。
关键词：自闭症谱系障碍；情绪调节；焦虑；社会认知；神经机制
